title: Valve Inspector

reward.description: A red iron hand-wheel, warm to the touch. It turns smoothly in either direction.

hints: Start a counter at 0 and loop over each character: for v in valves: ...
For the longest run, keep two numbers: the current run and the best run so far. Reset the current run when you see an 'O'.
For toggle, build a new string one character at a time with result = result + ...
